original_effects.evidence: At native pixels the cream wall carries plaster mottling, seams and drawn marks, while the blue jamb carries irregular bright paint chips. Tiny image-plane brightness grain independently visible across these midtone planes is not established; rain remains external. Material marks cannot satisfy film grain.

A warm orange rim/glow follows portions of the exposed glass bulb rather than a metal shade, but nearly all of the luminous outline projects over the cream wall. The dark roof beam lies above the socket, not behind the bright bulb contour. The frozen bulb-against-dark-beam relation is only partially realized.

The cheek changes smoothly from warm pale highlights to pink/beige skin while its form remains legible; cup-glaze highlights retain stipple and its vertical repaired seam; crumpled paper transitions from tan creases to pale warm facets without broad clipped white plates. All three declared materials show visible gradual bright transitions.
